card.name: Digits inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit token that begins or sits inside a multi-digit number in dosing text, such as the 7 or 5 in 750 mg, 250 mg or 100 mg. It also fires on a lone digit before a unit or fraction.

modes.label: Inside multi-digit doses
modes.description: A digit within a larger dose figure, followed by more digits and then mg or mL.

modes.label: Leading small digit
modes.description: A single digit starting a count, ratio or conversion, such as 2 times or 2.2 lbs.

card.plain: It fires on the digits within dose amounts like 750 mg or 100 mg/mL.
